# lumen/src/ui/bits.rs

Building blocks.

- `lucide(Glyph)`, `glyph`, `glyph_tile` (tinted tile).
- `icon`, `icon_slot` — `IconSpec` → widget; theme icons, file-type icons.
- `thumbnail` — scaled image, cached (`clear_thumbnails`).
- `keys(combo)` — keycaps.
- `mark(size)` — Lumen logo.
- `label`, `ellipsized`, `hbox`, `vbox`, `button`.
- `highlight_markup(text, indexes)` — bold fuzzy matches.
